transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been having a hard time with eating. After work or class I’ll sit with my laptop and then I end up eating a whole takeout meal, plus chips or sweets, whatever snacks I have around. It’s just… a lot more than I meant to, and more than I’d eat if someone else was there.
Do you feel like you can't stop eating or control how much you're eating during these episodes?

Yeah… I think so. Once I start, it’s like I keep reaching for the next thing even though I’m telling myself to stop. Like, I’ll be thinking I need to finish a budget report, and I’m not even really enjoying the food anymore, but I still keep going.
Are you usually feeling stressed, anxious, or upset when these eating episodes happen?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I haven’t really paid that much attention to what I’m feeling right before. It’s usually just after the day is over and I’m tired, I guess.
Do you usually feel guilty after eating this way?
I’m not really sure. I mean… sometimes I feel kind of bad about it, but I don’t know if I’d call it guilt exactly.
Do you feel like you're in control of your eating during these episodes?

Not really. Once I start, it kind of feels like I’m just… watching myself keep grabbing the next thing, even while I’m thinking, like, Jaime, stop, you have work to finish. I’m not even enjoying it anymore, but I still keep going.
Do you ever make yourself vomit or try to get rid of the calories after one of these eating episodes?
Um… I don’t really know. I mean, I don’t think so. Not like… on purpose or anything.
Do you ever exercise more than usual after one of these eating episodes to try to burn off the calories?
I don’t think so… I mean, I’m not really someone who goes and works out after. I haven’t noticed doing that, anyway.
Do you have episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time, and then you don't do anything to try to get rid of the calories or make up for it?

Yeah… that’s basically what happens. I’ll get home from work or class and sit with my laptop, and then it turns into a whole takeout meal plus chips or sweets or whatever’s in my desk drawer. It’s… a lot more than I meant to eat, and I don’t really do anything afterward to make up for it.
How often do these episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time happen?

Um… I guess most weeks. I looked back at my journal and some food delivery charges, and it’s been happening since the restructuring started. Usually more than once a week… not just like, once in a while.
Do you ever use laxatives or diuretics after one of these eating episodes?
No… I don’t think so. I don’t really use that kind of stuff after.
How many times a month would you say these episodes of eating a large amount of food in a short time typically happen?
Maybe… six or seven times a month? I didn’t count exactly, but looking at my journal and delivery charges, it’s most weeks, usually more than once a week.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
I’m not really sure. I don’t weigh myself much… I haven’t noticed anything major, I guess.
On average, how many days a week do you have one of these episodes where you eat a large amount of food in a short time?

Probably… like one or two days a week, most weeks. When I looked back at my journal and delivery charges, it wasn’t just random here and there. It’s been happening pretty regularly since the restructuring started.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop yourself from continuing to eat during these episodes, even if you want to?

Yeah… I mean, that’s kind of the worst part. Once I start, it’s like I’m just watching myself keep grabbing the next thing, even while I’m thinking, Jaime, stop, you have work to finish… and I’m not even really enjoying it anymore.
Do you ever fast or severely restrict your food intake after one of these eating episodes?
I’m not sure… I don’t think I do that, really. I might eat less the next day if I feel kind of gross, but not like… on purpose starving myself or anything.
Have you had any periods of significant weight loss followed by weight gain since these eating episodes started?
I don’t think so. My weight’s gone up and down a little, but I haven’t noticed any big drop and then regain or anything like that.
Have you noticed any times where you lost a lot of weight and then gained it back since these eating episodes started?
Not really. I mean… my weight shifts a little, but I haven’t noticed anything like losing a lot and then gaining it all back.
Have you ever had a period where you lost a significant amount of weight?
No… I don’t think I’ve ever lost a significant amount. Not that I noticed, anyway.
Have you ever had a period where your weight went up significantly and then you lost that weight again?
Not that I can think of. My weight’s changed some, but I don’t remember it going up a lot and then dropping back down.
Have you ever had a period where you lost more than 10 pounds and then gained it back?
No… I don’t think so. Not more than 10 pounds and then gaining it back, at least not that I’ve noticed.
